scope: Expedition v2 independent static and Node model review. No browser execution or quality acceptance.

model_evidence.periodic_replay_state_comparison: 781 comparisons passed, normalizing the documented restore pause
conservation_equations: node remaining + delivered + carried + lost = initial node total
coverage_limits: No rendered browser, accessibility interaction or visual acceptance performed.
Random model checks are not exhaustive proof of balance or exploit resistance.
targeted_rechecks: Loaded chapter-2 wood reassignment to idle preserves four-second return, delivering at t=10 rather than t=8.
2400 pause/resume cycles leave canonical log length at one.
Full 2400-action checkpoint restores paused, resumes, steps, pauses and restores again.
repository_scripts_rerun: scripts/test_expedition_v2_controller.mjs: passed; simulated DOM/callback harness, not a browser
final_revision_checks: Both repository model/controller scripts rerun successfully after simultaneous chapter-3 raid addition.
Six ordinary-command policies win. Same-cost simultaneous-raid comparison: concentrated defense loses 22 base HP; split defense loses zero base HP with greater guard injury.
Static review confirms toBuild uses return-route interpolation rather than immediate construction-site placement.
Independent 100-run randomized conservation/replay check repeated against final reviewed hashes.

positive_findings: Resource conservation held across random accepted/rejected command interleavings.
Resources are credited only on return or builder arrival, and finite nodes bound total harvest.
Paused stepping freezes model time; terminal stepping does not advance the model.
Replay reconstructs accepted commands rather than trusting resource snapshots.
Documented goals are cumulative delivered resources, so spending does not erase goal progress.
acceptance_statement: Model review evidence only. This report does not establish browser usability, visual quality, fun, or final release acceptance.

resolved_findings.finding: Running render replaces worker selects and action/deployment buttons every 250 ms, removing focus and interfering with keyboard operation.
resolved_findings.evidence: frame invokes render after each simulation step; render uses replaceChildren on workers/actions/deployment and creates replacement controls.
resolved_findings.verification: Static review confirms persistent worker/action/deployment nodes; controller harness passes identity retention. Actual browser keyboard interaction remains unverified.

resolved_findings.finding: A valid running checkpoint with 2399 commands is restored paused at 2400 commands and can never resume.
reproduction: Execute 1199 pause/resume pairs without stepping; accepted log length becomes 2399.
Restore checkpoint; automatic pause makes log length 2400.
Resume is rejected with command-limit error.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent exact-cap restore/resume/step assertions pass; pause/resume do not consume canonical replay budget.

resolved_findings.finding: Reassigning loaded workers recomputes return duration using the new task, enabling shorter delivery routes.
reproduction: In chapter 2, assign worker 1 to wood at t=0.
At t=6 the worker carries 6 wood with 4 seconds remaining on the return.
Assign idle; remaining becomes 2 seconds and cargo arrives at t=8 instead of t=10.
resolved_findings.impact: Conserves resources but rewards unintended task-switch micro-management.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent original reproduction now delivers at t=10; remaining return duration is unchanged by assignment.

resolved_findings.finding: Defense hint describes continuous attacks although each wave resolves once five seconds after its advertised arrival.
resolved_findings.verification: Defense hint now explicitly describes five-second response window and one-time damage settlement.

resolved_findings.finding: Caps count dead as well as living workers/guards; displayed living counts can be below the cap while recruitment is rejected.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Document lifetime caps, or count living units if replacement recruitment is intended.
resolved_findings.verification: Recruitment now counts living units plus queued units; repository replacement-worker regression passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Worker interpolation assumes a four-second trip and marching guard art is placed at its target immediately. Engine itself does retain movement delays.
resolved_findings.verification: Worker interpolation uses stored original route/travel duration; guards interpolate from prior front to target.
toBuild now uses original-route return interpolation; no browser visual acceptance claimed.

bounded_limitations.description: 2400 substantive accepted commands remain a bounded per-game action limit; pause/resume and restore remain available at the cap.
No actual browser rendering, keyboard/select behavior, layout or visual-quality acceptance performed.
Pre-remediation draft checkpoints containing pause/resume commands now fail strict restore. Existing invalid bytes remain protected until confirmed reset; draft schema migration was not implemented.
